players.product: data center buildings owned and operated for GPU clusters (owner / operator of the Columbus, Georgia site hosting Axe Compute's B300 cluster)

quarterly_data.signal: Duos Technologies 8-K: on September 30, 2026 Duos sold 100% of Duos Edge AI - GPUaaS, LLC, the SPV holding its Columbus GPU cluster of 288 Supermicro B300 servers (2,304 GPUs) and networking equipment, to Axe Compute; following the closing Duos will lease the underlying GPU compute capacity from Axe Compute under a capacity supply arrangement, continues to own and operate the Columbus colocation facility (power, cooling, security, managed infrastructure) and will continue to serve the existing customer without interruption under a revised five-year agreement it expects to increase the revenue it recognizes. Duos is now a pure-play colocation landlord directing capital exclusively to 10 to 30 MW modular colocation sites; its 2026 outlook is unchanged - full-year revenue above $50 million and positive adjusted EBITDA (CFO Chris DeAlmeida).
quarterly_data.figure: 288 servers, 2,304 GPUs sold September 30, 2026; 2026 revenue above $50 million
